title: Young musicians in the Lions parade
summary: Younger players in the old style, including a tuba player and Lester Wright.

story.theme_name: Lester Young: the man, the sound, the Basie years
story.community_name: Remembering Lester Young: Prez the man and his sound

blocks.x: Do you want some more questions? Yes. Do you have some questions? Did you ask him about the parade there and the younger musicians you heard in them? Such as the trombonist with the Jefferson City Puzzards or the tuba player with the Lions?
He didn't go to that parade, by the way, in the first one. No, I will.
Haben Sie irgendwelche jüngeren Musiker hier gehört, die aber im alten Spiel, im alten Stil spielen?
Ja, das war auf der Lions Parade, der tuba-Spieler und den jungen kleinen Artisten, der da spielte, Lester Wright.
Evans Morrison was a tuba player. Oh, ja.
Sousaphone, right? Ja, die passen recht gut in die Sache und es ist erfreulich, dass ich hier in New Orleans doch junge Leute finde, die in diesem alten Stil spielen wollen.
